title: 第0003章灵材异动菜市玄机第0004章厨技御敌凝灵初显
content_zh:
第0003章灵材异动，菜市玄机清晨的阳光穿透云层，给湿漉漉的城中村镀上一层暖金。
巴刀鱼的小餐馆刚收拾干净，
玻璃门上的水珠还在顺着纹路滑落，
就被一阵急促的敲门声打破了宁静。
“刀哥！不好了！”门外传来邻居老张慌张的声音，伴随着断断续续的咳嗽。
巴刀鱼拉开门，只见老张脸色惨白，
嘴角挂着一丝青黑色的血迹，怀里抱着一个竹篮，
篮子里的青菜蔫头耷脑，叶片上竟浮现出细密的黑色纹路。
“老张，怎么回事？”他连忙扶住摇摇欲坠的老张，鼻尖嗅到一股淡淡的腐臭味，与昨天丧彪身上的食煞气息有些相似，却更阴冷。
“我……我早上去菜市场批菜，看到角落里的菜摊不对劲，
那些菜长得特别好，颜色鲜得发亮，我就买了点，结果刚拿到手，就觉得浑身发冷，
喉咙里像堵了块冰……”老张说着，突然剧烈咳嗽起来，咳出的痰液里竟夹杂着细小的黑色絮状物。
酸菜汤从后厨走出来，看到老张的模样，脸色瞬间凝重：
“是‘腐煞’！比食煞更凶险，是灵材被邪祟污染后产生的煞气，普通人接触后，三日内就会被侵蚀脏腑而亡。”
她快步走到竹篮边，指尖凝聚起一丝淡红色的玄力，
轻轻触碰青菜上的黑色纹路，玄力刚一接触，就被一股阴冷的力量弹开，
青菜上的黑纹反而更浓郁了几分。
“腐煞？”巴刀鱼皱眉，想起黄片姜昨天的话，
玄界缝隙渗出的玄气既能滋养灵材，也能滋生邪祟，“这菜是从哪个摊位买的？”
“就是菜市场西北角，那个新来的独眼老头的摊位！”

老张虚弱地说道，“他的菜特别便宜，好多摊贩都去批，
刚才我看到好几个买了他菜的人，都跟我一样浑身发冷……”
酸菜汤眼神一凛：“是食魇教的人！他们不仅用邪祟污染灵材，
还把这些带煞的灵材流入市井，想通过普通人的负面情绪壮大力量！”
她转头看向巴刀鱼，“我们必须尽快去菜市场，阻止那个独眼老头，不然会有更多人遭殃！”
巴刀鱼点点头，转身对娃娃鱼说：“小鱼，你留在餐馆里，把门窗关好，不管谁敲门都别开，我们很快回来。”
“刀哥，我也想去！”娃娃鱼攥着衣角，眼神里满是担忧，“我能感觉到那些煞气，说不定能帮上忙！”
她的额头微微发光，一股微弱的白色玄力萦绕在周身，
这是她觉醒的灵族天赋，能感知到玄界邪祟的气息。
巴刀鱼犹豫了一下，酸菜汤开口道：“让她一起吧，她的感知能力或许能帮我们找到藏在暗处的邪祟。”
当下，三人搀扶着老张进屋休息，留下一些温水和普通的清淡小菜，便急匆匆地赶往菜市场。
清晨的菜市场人声鼎沸，吆喝声、讨价还价声此起彼伏，可空气中却弥漫着一股若有若无的腐臭味，仔细分辨，还能察觉到几缕阴冷的煞气在人群中流转。
巴刀鱼跟着娃娃鱼的指引，很快就找到了西北角的摊位——一个独眼老头正坐在马扎上，
面前摆着各种色泽鲜亮的蔬菜，绿油油的青菜、红彤彤的番茄、紫莹莹的茄子，每一样都比普通蔬菜饱满，却在叶片边缘或果皮上，隐藏着淡淡的黑色纹路。
几个摊贩正围在摊位前批菜，丝毫没有察觉到异常。
独眼老头的独眼里闪烁着诡异的绿光，嘴角挂着一丝不易察觉的冷笑，
手指在蔬菜上轻轻拂过，每触碰一次，蔬菜上的黑纹就淡去几分，
看起来更像是新鲜的好菜。
content_en:
Chapter 0003: The spiritual material moves strangely, and the mystery of the vegetable market. The early morning sun penetrates the clouds, coating the wet urban village with a layer of warm gold.
The small restaurant of Badiyu has just been cleaned up.
The water drops on the glass door are still sliding along the lines.
The silence was broken by a rapid knock on the door.
"Brother Dao! It's not good!" The neighbor's panicked voice came from outside the door, accompanied by intermittent coughing.
Ba Yu opened the door and saw Lao Zhang's face pale.
There was a trace of blue-black blood hanging from the corner of his mouth, and he held a bamboo basket in his arms.
The green vegetables in the basket were wilted, and fine black lines appeared on the leaves.
"Lao Zhang, what's going on?" He quickly supported the crumbling Lao Zhang, and smelled a faint rancid smell at the tip of his nose, which was somewhat similar to the Shisha smell on Sangbiao yesterday, but even colder.
"I...I went to the vegetable market to batch vegetables in the morning and saw something was wrong with the vegetable stall in the corner.
Those vegetables grew very well and were brightly colored, so I bought some. As soon as I got them, I felt cold all over.
It feels like there is a block of ice in my throat..." Lao Zhang said, suddenly coughing violently, and the sputum he coughed up was actually mixed with tiny black flocs.
Pickled cabbage soup came out of the back kitchen, and when he saw Lao Zhang's appearance, his face instantly became solemn:
"It's a 'corruption evil'! It's more dangerous than the food evil. It's the evil spirit produced when spiritual materials are contaminated by evil spirits. If ordinary people come into contact with it, their internal organs will be eroded and they will die within three days."
She walked quickly to the bamboo basket, a trace of light red profound energy condensing on her fingertips,
He gently touched the black lines on the green vegetables. As soon as the mysterious force came into contact, he was bounced away by a cold force.
The black lines on the green vegetables are actually a bit more intense.
"Fu evil spirit?" Batio fish frowned, remembering Huang Pianjiang's words yesterday,
The mysterious energy seeping out from the gaps in the mysterious world can nourish spiritual materials and breed evil spirits. "Which stall did you buy this dish from?"
"It's the stall of the new one-eyed old man in the northwest corner of the vegetable market!"
Lao Zhang said weakly, "His food is very cheap, and many vendors go to approve it.
Just now I saw several people who bought his food, and they were all as cold as me..."
Pickled Cabbage Soup's eyes were sharp: "They are people from the Nightmare Eater Sect! Not only do they contaminate spiritual materials with evil spirits,
They also put these evil spirit materials into the market, hoping to increase their power through the negative emotions of ordinary people! "
She turned to look at the fish, "We must go to the vegetable market as soon as possible to stop the one-eyed old man, otherwise more people will suffer!"
The baby fish nodded, turned around and said to the baby fish: "Xiaoyu, you stay in the restaurant, close the doors and windows, and don't open the door no matter who knocks. We will be back soon."
"Brother Dao, I want to go too!" Baby Fish clutched the corner of his clothes, his eyes full of worry, "I can feel those evil spirits, maybe I can help!"
Her forehead glowed slightly, and a weak white mysterious energy lingered around her body.
This is her awakened spiritual talent, which allows her to sense the evil aura of the mysterious world.
Basioyu hesitated for a moment, then Pickled Cabbage Soup said: "Let her come with us. Her perceptual ability may help us find the evil spirits hiding in the dark."
At that moment, the three of them helped Lao Zhang into the house to rest, leaving some warm water and ordinary light dishes, and hurried to the vegetable market.
The vegetable market in the early morning was bustling with people, shouting and bargaining, but there was a faint rotten smell in the air. If you look carefully, you can still detect a few wisps of cold evil spirit circulating among the crowd.
The giant salamander followed the giant salamander's guidance and soon found the stall in the northwest corner - a one-eyed old man was sitting on the horse.
A variety of brightly colored vegetables were placed in front of him, including green vegetables, bright red tomatoes, and purple eggplants. Each of them was plumper than ordinary vegetables, but there were faint black lines hidden on the edges of the leaves or on the peel.
Several vendors were gathering in front of the stall to sell vegetables, and they didn't notice anything unusual.
The one-eyed old man's single eye flashedA strange green light, with an imperceptible sneer hanging on the corner of his mouth,
My fingers gently brushed over the vegetables. Every time I touched them, the dark lines on the vegetables faded a little.
Looks more like fresh good food.
